svg.title: Approximate composition of dry air by volume

desc.style: color: rgb(34, 34, 34); fill: rgb(0, 0, 0); fill-opacity: 1; fill-rule: nonzero; stroke: none; stroke-width: 1px; stroke-opacity: 1; stroke-dasharray: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-linejoin: miter; opacity: 1; font-size: 14px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal; text-anchor: start; dominant-baseline: auto; letter-spacing: normal; visibility: visible; paint-order: normal; marker: none;

svg.desc: Nitrogen about 78 percent, oxygen about 21 percent and other gases about 1 percent. Carbon dioxide is variable and is approximately 0.04 percent in contemporary near-surface dry air, rather than the historical 0.03 percent in the replaced illustration.
